setup: single RTX A6000, Qwen3.8-27B-FP8, vLLM 0.32.0, enforce_eager, max_model_len=4096
input_protocol: same three 2-second timestamped JPEG-video windows and same prompt for MTP-1 and MTP-3; separate 18-20s video warm-up window per server is excluded
timer_definition: client timings start immediately before POST and include HTTP/service overhead; server metrics separately expose TTFT, generation time, queue and ITL

warmup_excluded.prompt:
Task instruction: Observe the object placement order, remember it, then place the corresponding objects into the basket in the same order.
Observation interval: 18.00s through 20.00s.
Earlier memory: No events recorded yet.

Maintain a chronological text event log. Write only information visibly supported by these images that is new or shows a change. Keep each event concise and in observed order. Describe actions as in progress unless the images show their outcome. Do not include timestamps; the system adds the interval time. If no new event is visible, return an empty string.
Return exactly one JSON object and no Markdown: {"memory_update": string}
warmup_excluded.output: {"memory_update": "A white robotic arm descends from above toward the center of the table, moving downward and slightly forward."}
